analysis_plan.descriptive: Median and interquartile range across seeds; hourly process metrics; mean mortality Monte Carlo t intervals.
analysis_plan.effects: Mean seed-paired mortality difference in percentage points with a 95% Monte Carlo t interval; no empirical intervention-effect interpretation.
analysis_plan.families: Organization levels; organization channels including baseline and both channels; distance within each of three capacities; fleet within each of two sites.
analysis_plan.omnibus: Friedman test blocked by seed, with Holm correction across seven prespecified families.
analysis_plan.pairwise: All within-family mortality pairs; exact paired sign-flip tests of mean differences with Holm correction within family.
analysis_plan.precision: Report interval half-widths and flag those exceeding 0.5 percentage points; do not extend sampling based on significance.
